issue.title: Regression: show techsupport traceback seen while getting queue counters

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Previous Working Version

202205

### Steps to Reproduce

Below traceback is seen while running "show techsupport" on multi-asic device.

Traceback seen when getting queue counters, traceback is printed and continues execution of show techsupport.
```
sonic-netns-exec asic0 show queue counters | dummy_cleanup_method &> '/var/dump/sonic_dump_foo/dump/queue.counters_2.0'"

    return self.main(*args, **kwargs)

    rv = self.invoke(ctx)
         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

    return ctx.invoke(self.callback, **ctx.params)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 555, in invoke
    return callback(*args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/bin/queuestat", line 450, in main
    queuestat_wrapper.run(save_fresh_stats, port_to_show_stats, json_opt, non_zero)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/utilities_common/multi_asic.py", line 142, in wrapped_run_on_all_asics
    ns_list = self.multi_asic.get_ns_list_based_on_options()
              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

    config_db_handle[namespace] =  connect_config_db_for_ns(namespace)
```

Queue counters will be missing in "show techsupport" for multi-asic device.

resolution.title: [chassis][show_tech]Fix show queue counters to only run on host
resolution.description:
#### What I did
`show queue counters` is supported and runs on host instance, even for mult-asic platforms.
We don't have to run `show queue counters` for each asic namespace.

This fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22394

#### How I did it
Modifiy generate_dump to call `save_cmd` instead of `save_cmd_all_ns` for `show queue counters`

#### How to verify it
Run `show techsupport` on multi-asic platform.
Verfiy that  the `queue.counters` files show correct information.

#### Which release branch to backport (provide reason below if selected)

 - [ ] 202305
 - [x] 202405
